This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

```bash
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
```

- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). - `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. ## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

125	### 4.2 history_marks 测量
126	
127	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
128	
129	`history_tokens` 只给「本请求的会话历史」找到一个恢复点。但会话里**更早的每一轮**也各有自己的边界——每个「后面跟着 assistant 消息」的消息处，都结束过某个更早的请求。一个保留多个快照的调度器（如 pooled tier）可以从其中任何一个恢复下一轮，多一个候选就多一次命中前缀缓存的机会。
130	
131	于是这一层顺手把这些更早边界也量出来，作为 `vllm_xargs.history_marks`，**新者在先**（newest first）。每个 mark 的定义：**到该消息为止的会话前缀，按不带 generation prompt 渲染后的 token 数**——恰好就是「当初携带那个轮次的请求」的 history_tokens（见 [history.rs:L32-L43](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/history.rs#L32-L43) 的模块文档）。
132	
133	代价控制：只测最新的 `MARKS = 8` 个，且每个 mark 都要渲染一次「到该处为止的会话」——一条长 agent trace 只为少数几个边界付费，而不是每轮一次。容错：模板在更长会话里把某边界分词得不同，只会产出一个「没有快照落在其上」的 mark，代价是 miss，仅此而已。

198	### 4.3 normalize_chat_requests：effort 别名规范化与洋葱顺序
199	
200	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
201	
202	OpenAI 的 `reasoning_effort` 词表是 `none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max`，但**具体 checkpoint 的 chat 模板可能只认更窄的词表**：Qwen3.8 的模板只接受 `xhigh|medium|low`，其它值直接 `raise_exception`——而 pinned 的 vendored 前端把这次 raise 变成 **500 而不是 400**。调用方发一个完全合法的 OpenAI 值 `high`，却得到服务器内部错误。
203	
204	这一层的职责：在请求到达路由**之前**，把模板不认识的值改写成语义最近的别名（`high`/`max` → `xhigh`，`minimal` → `low`）。两条设计纪律让它不至于变成「拍脑袋映射」：
205	
206	1. **改写集由被服务模板自己裁决**：启动时用同一渲染器对每个候选值渲染一个最小请求，只有「模板拒绝 from 且接受 to」的别名才启用。模板本来就接受 OpenAI 值的线（今天的所有非 Qwen3.8 线，包括 Kimi K3）一个改写都不启用，调用方的值逐字到达。
207	2. **探测有前置闸门**：只有 config.json（顶层或 `text_config`）带 `output_gate_type` 标记的 Qwen3.8 一类存档才值得探测，其它线零启动开销。

209	两条**故意不改写**的通道（见 [reasoning_effort.rs:L20-L26](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L20-L26)）：显式的 `chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort`（调用方在直接对模板说话）与逐请求的 `chat_template` 覆盖（其词表启动探测从未量过）。两者保留完全控制权，代价是值越界时由它们自己承担拒绝。

211	**洋葱顺序**（[mod.rs:L493-L500](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs#L493-L500)）：`normalize_chat_requests(mark_history(extend_router(router)))`——effort 层包在 history 层**外面**。注释一句话点题：*"Effort normalization is outermost so the boundary measures the template under the value the route will render with."* 4.1.3 里我们看到边界测量的 `chat_options` 会读 `reasoning_effort` 并用它渲染；若 effort 层在内层，边界会在**改写前**的值下测 T——而模板的 generation prompt（如思考分支的开合）可以随 effort 变化，T 就可能量错。外层先改写，内层量到的才是路由真正要渲染的世界。

251	**错误信封**（[reasoning_effort.rs:L233-L252](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L233-L252)）：`body_read_error` 复刻 `vllm_server` 的 `ApiError::to_error_response` 形状；`LengthLimitError` 独占 413，注释说明这层出现之前路由报的就是 400，非超长读失败保持该类别。

268	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
269	
270	**练习 1**：为什么探测只在带 `output_gate_type` 标记的存档上跑，而不是所有模型都跑一遍？
271	**答案**：省启动开销只是次要原因；更根本的是**正当性**：别名表的语义是「这个模板拒绝 from、接受 to」。绝大多数线的模板接受全部 OpenAI 值，探测结果必然是空表；标记把「已知会限制 effort 词表的这一代存档」圈出来，让其它线连一次渲染探测都不必付，也绝不冒误改写的险。

273	**练习 2**：请求带 `"chat_template": "{{ '' }}"` 且 `reasoning_effort: "high"`，会发生什么？
274	**答案**：原样放行，不改写（`rewrite_reasoning_effort` 的覆盖守卫）。理由：这张临时模板的词表启动探测从未量过——它可能接受 `high`，按默认模板的权威把 `high` 改成 `xhigh` 反而可能弄坏一个本来能渲染的请求。测试 `a_per_request_template_override_keeps_the_callers_effort_value`（[reasoning_effort.rs:L325-L340](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L325-L340)）同时验证了 `chat_template: null`（无覆盖）时改写照常生效。

276	**练习 3**：把两层洋葱反过来包（history 在外、effort 在内），哪个数量会错、怎么错？
277	**答案**：会错的是 T。边界测量的 `chat_options` 从 body 读 `reasoning_effort`（history.rs 第 217 行）并用它渲染两次；effort 在内层意味着测量发生在改写**之前**，模板实际会以改写后的值渲染（例如 thinking 分支的开合随 effort 变化，generation prompt 的 token 数随之不同）。测出的 T 对应的是调用方发来的值，而路由渲染用的是改写后的值——快照点落在错误的 token 上，下一轮从快照恢复就会差几个 token。
278	
279	## 5. 综合实践
280	
281	**任务：给 echo-server 发两轮对话，推算并（可选）观测第二轮的 `history_tokens` 与 `history_marks`。**
282	
283	1. **准备**：从工作区根目录运行 `cargo run -p pegainfer-frontend --example echo-server`（无 GPU、无权重；模型 fixture 在 [examples/echo-model/](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-model/config.json#L1-L6)，其 config 无 `output_gate_type` 标记——顺带确认：这个部署的 effort 别名表必然为空，第一层洋葱实际是透传的）。
284	2. **第一轮**：`curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"model":"echo","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}],"max_tokens":64}'`，记下 assistant 回复（echo 线把 prompt 吐回来）。
285	3. **第二轮**：构造 body：`messages = [第一轮 user, 第一轮 assistant 回复, 新的 user 消息]`，再次请求。
286	4. **手工推算**（依据 4.1/4.2 的算法，按结构推）：
287	   - 第二轮请求恰有一个历史边界（第一轮 user 消息后面跟着 assistant 消息），所以 `history_marks` 是**单元素**向量；
288	   - 该元素的值 =「到第一轮 user 为止的会话，不带 generation prompt 渲染后的 token 数」= 第一轮请求**当时的** `history_tokens`；
289	   - 第二轮的 `history_tokens` = 第二轮整条 prompt 的 token 数 − T（T 默认 mode 下 ≥ 1）；桥侧过滤后必有 `marks[0] < history_tokens`。
290	   - echo-model 无 `tokenizer_config.json`，chat 路由用 vendored 默认模板渲染——**具体数值无法纸面确定，待本地验证**。
291	5. **（可选）观测**：echo-server 不初始化日志后端，`debug!` 不会输出；想看到真实数字，可在自己检出的 [history.rs:L435-L450](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/history.rs#L435-L450) 的 `mark_generation_prompt` 里临时加一行 `eprintln!("T={tokens:?} marks={marks:?}")`，重跑 echo-server 发第二轮请求，观测后还原。观测值应满足第 4 步的结构断言。
292	6. **核验**：把推算结果对照 [step.rs:L51-L67](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/step.rs#L51-L67) 的两个字段注释逐句核对——你的每个数是否都能在注释里找到一句话为其背书。
293	7. **答问**：向 echo-server 发 `{"messages":[...],"add_generation_prompt":false}` 或最后一条是 assistant 且 `continue_final_message:true` 的请求时，T 是多少、`history_tokens` 是多少、这对快照恢复意味着什么？（答案：T=0，`history_tokens = L − 0 = L`，整个 prompt 都是 history——因为根本没有「即将生成的尾巴」，会话的下一轮会从 prompt 的**最后一个 token** 之后接着重复，快照点就在 prompt 末尾。）
294	
295	## 6. 本讲小结
296	
297	- **边界测量的形态**：chat 层在路由前面把最后一条消息单独渲染两遍（带/不带 generation prompt），\( T = |W| - \operatorname{LCP}(W, W') \)；跨界 token 计入 T，边界只向历史方向退。桥侧用只有它知道的整条 prompt 长度做 \( h = L - T \)（`checked_sub`，装不下即 `None`）。
298	- **marks 是「更早轮次的 history_tokens」**：每个被 assistant 消息紧跟的消息处结束过一个更早请求；到该处为止、按请求自己的工具上下文、不带尾巴渲染的 token 数即 mark。新者在先、至多 8 个、桥侧严格小于 `history_tokens` 才保留——供 pooled tier 从更早快照恢复。
299	- **测量用的是路由自己的 renderer 与 tokenizer**，mode/模板控制逐字段复刻路由解析；`add_generation_prompt=false` 与 `continue_final_message=true` 都使 T=0、整个 prompt 是 history。
300	- **读不懂就放行**：非 JSON、无 messages、渲染失败、backends 未加载——任何一层量不动都不报错，body 原样穿过，调度器看到 `None`/空，错误留给路由自己报。两个键是「服务器对自己模板的测量」，调用方带同名键会被覆盖。
301	- **effort 规范化由模板裁决**：启动探测渲染每个候选值，`!accepts(from) && accepts(to)` 才武装别名（`high/max→xhigh`、`minimal→low`）；`output_gate_type` 标记是「值得探测」的闸门而非改写命令；`chat_template_kwargs` 直连与逐请求 `chat_template` 覆盖两条通道故意不改写。
302	- **洋葱顺序是正确性约束**：effort 最外、history 次外——边界必须用「路由真正渲染用的值」量 T；测量与渲染在 `spawn_blocking` 里做，秒级渲染不压 async worker；改写后重写 `Content-Length`，超长独占 413、其它读失败保持 400，共用 OpenAI 错误信封。
303	
304	## 7. 下一步学习建议
305	
306	- **u4-l5（特殊服务面）**：看同一洋葱里最内层 `extend_router` 的另外两个形态——prefill-only 门与 LoRA 路由合并，理解「整形层」与「能力路由层」的分工。
307	- **u4-l6（可观测性）**：marks 命中与否最终体现在 prefix-cache 计数器上；去看 `SchedulerMetrics` 的 `prefix_cache` 累计计数如何从调度器走到 `/metrics`，把本讲的「快照 miss 只是 miss」落到数字上。
308	- **源码延伸**：带快照语义的调度器如何消费 `history_tokens`/`history_marks`，可从 `pegainfer-qwen3` 或 `pegainfer-qwen35`（Gated DeltaNet 线，正是「状态不能回滚」的动机来源）的调度器代码里 grep `history_tokens` 入手；`docs/models/qwen35/` 下有对应的模型线文档。

# u4-l4 · 请求整形：history 边界测量与 reasoning effort 规范化

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u4-l2）我们看到 vLLM 装配骨架在路由外面包了三层洋葱，其中两层是「请求整形」中间层：`mark_history` 与 `normalize_chat_requests`。本讲把这两层拆开精读。学完后你应该能够：

1. **复述边界测量算法**：中间层如何只渲染最后一条消息、比较「带 / 不带 generation prompt」两次 tokenization 的公共前缀得到尾长 `T`，桥侧如何据此置 `history_tokens = prompt_len - T`。
2. **解释 `history_marks`（新者在先）的语义**：它为什么是「更早回合各自曾经的 `history_tokens`」，保留多快照的调度器如何用它从更早边界恢复下一轮。
3. **说明 effort 规范化为什么必须放在最外层**：边界测量要用「路由真正渲染用的那个 effort 值」去渲染，顺序错了 `T` 就可能量错。
4. 读懂这两层「读不懂就原样放行」的降级哲学，以及 `add_generation_prompt=false` / `continue_final_message=true` 时 `T=0`、整个 prompt 都是 history 的含义。

## 2. 前置知识

- **axum 中间层（middleware layer）**：axum 允许用 `router.layer(...)` 给一组路由外包一层处理函数；请求先穿过外层再到达路由，响应再穿出来。多层 `layer` 的包裹顺序是「后包的在外」——本讲的洋葱顺序就是靠调用顺序写出来的。
- **chat 模板渲染（chat template rendering）**：OpenAI 风格的 `/v1/chat/completions` 请求带一个 `messages` 数组；服务端要用模型自带的 Jinja 风格 chat 模板把它渲染成模型真正看到的 prompt 文本，再分词成 token 序列。模板最后通常还会追加一段「generation prompt」（如 Qwen3.8 的 `<|im_start|>assistant\n<think>\n`），意思是「轮到 assistant 说话了」。
- **`vllm_xargs` 侧信道**：请求 JSON 里的一个对象字段，不参与采样语义，专门用来把自定义键值对原样带到引擎侧（桥在 `sampling_params.extra_args` 里读它）。本讲测出的两个数就藏在这里过境。
- **前缀快照与恢复（快照续跑）**：u3-l3 介绍过 step 契约的 `Request`。其中 `history_tokens` / `history_marks` 是为「状态不能回滚的调度器」（如线性注意力 / recurrent 线）准备的前缀坐标：会话下一轮会逐字重复上一轮的历史，若在历史末尾存了状态快照，下一轮就能从快照处继续而不必重算 prefill。
- **公共前缀（LCP）**：两个序列逐位比较、取相同部分的最长长度。本讲的尾长 `T` 就是用 LCP 算出来的差值。
- **`reasoning_effort`**：OpenAI chat 请求的一个顶层字段，取值 `none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max`，控制「思考多用力」；它会作为模板变量进入 chat 模板渲染。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/history.rs` | 本讲主角一：`Boundary` 测量器 + `mark_history` 中间层，测出 `generation_prompt_tokens`（尾长 T）与 `history_marks` 写入 `vllm_xargs` |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs` | 本讲主角二：启动期探测模板词表 + `normalize_chat_requests` 中间层，做 effort 别名改写 |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/step.rs` | step 契约的 `Request`：`history_tokens` / `history_marks` 字段的权威文档注释 |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/bridge/stepped.rs` | 消费点：stepped 桥从 `extra_args` 读出 T 与 marks，置 `history_tokens = prompt_len - T` 并过滤 marks |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs` | 装配点：加载 backends、构造 aliases 与 Boundary、决定两层洋葱的包裹顺序 |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-server.rs` | 无 GPU 的活体标本，本讲实践的载体 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 Boundary / history_tokens 测量

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

一个 chat prompt = 「渲染好的会话」+「模板的 generation prompt 尾巴」。同一会话的下一轮请求会把上一轮的回复**当作 history** 重新渲染——而 history 的渲染方式和 generation prompt 的读法不同，所以两轮 prompt 的最长公共前缀**在最后一条消息结束处截止**。一个状态不能回滚的调度器（recurrent 线）想服务下一轮，只能从这个边界上的快照恢复。

问题在于：上游 vendored 的 chat 路由后面的任何代码都**看不到请求文本**，也就不知道这个边界在哪。于是这一层站在路由**前面**把边界量出来，经 `vllm_xargs` → 桥，最终落到 [`crate::engine::Request::history_tokens`](../pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/step.rs#L60)。

关键直觉：**不需要渲染整个会话**。凡是「generation prompt 追加在 messages 之后」的模板（frontend 服务的所有模板都是），尾长 T 只取决于最后一条消息。所以量法是本地的、按请求一次的：把**最后一条消息单独**渲染两遍——一遍带 generation prompt、一遍不带——两个 token 序列的公共前缀之后的差值就是 T。

[history.rs:L1-L24](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/history.rs#L1-L24) 这段模块文档把「为什么边界存在、为什么只渲染最后一条消息、T 如何过境」讲得一清二楚，是全模块最好的一手材料。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

测量 T（`generation_prompt_tokens`）：

```text
输入: chat body (JSON)
1. chat_options(body):
     由 add_generation_prompt / continue_final_message 折算 GenerationPromptMode
     并带出 chat_template / reasoning_effort / chat_template_kwargs 等模板控制
2. 若该 mode 不产 generation prompt（NoGenerationPrompt / ContinueFinalAssistant）→ T = 0
3. last_message(body): 取 messages 的最后一条（读不出 → 整体放弃，None）
4. with    = tokenize(render([最后一条消息], mode = 原样))
   without = tokenize(render([最后一条消息], mode = NoGenerationPrompt))
5. shared = LCP(with, without)      # 逐 token 比较
6. T = |with| − shared
```

写成公式：

\[ T = |W| - \operatorname{LCP}(W, W') \]

其中 \(W\) 是带 generation prompt 的 tokenization，\(W'\) 是不带的。**跨界 token（straddling token）计入 T**——若某个 token 同时覆盖「历史结尾」和「generation prompt 开头」，公共前缀会提前一位断开，边界向历史方向退一个 token，绝不落进 generation prompt 里。

桥侧消费（`prompt_len` 只有桥知道，因为它看到的是完整 prompt 的 token id）：

\[ h = \text{history\_tokens} = L - T \qquad (L = |\text{prompt\_tokens}|) \]

`checked_sub` 保证 T 放不进整个 prompt 时得到 `None`（「一个 prompt 装不下的计数不是边界」）。

两个 T=0 的特例：`add_generation_prompt=false` 与 `continue_final_message=true` 都不渲染 generation prompt，于是 T=0、**整个 prompt 都是 history**——这正是 u4-l2 提过的「带/不带 generation prompt」两个渲染分支在测量侧的镜像。

降级规则：body 不是 JSON、没有 `messages`、最后一条消息渲染失败 → 原样放行，调度器看不到任何边界（`history_tokens = None`），路由自己会对它报错。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

### 4.2 history_marks 测量

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`history_tokens` 只给「本请求的会话历史」找到一个恢复点。但会话里**更早的每一轮**也各有自己的边界——每个「后面跟着 assistant 消息」的消息处，都结束过某个更早的请求。一个保留多个快照的调度器（如 pooled tier）可以从其中任何一个恢复下一轮，多一个候选就多一次命中前缀缓存的机会。

于是这一层顺手把这些更早边界也量出来，作为 `vllm_xargs.history_marks`，**新者在先**（newest first）。每个 mark 的定义：**到该消息为止的会话前缀，按不带 generation prompt 渲染后的 token 数**——恰好就是「当初携带那个轮次的请求」的 history_tokens（见 [history.rs:L32-L43](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/history.rs#L32-L43) 的模块文档）。

代价控制：只测最新的 `MARKS = 8` 个，且每个 mark 都要渲染一次「到该处为止的会话」——一条长 agent trace 只为少数几个边界付费，而不是每轮一次。容错：模板在更长会话里把某边界分词得不同，只会产出一个「没有快照落在其上」的 mark，代价是 miss，仅此而已。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
输入: chat body (JSON)
前置: 读出全部 messages（任何一条读不出 → marks 为空）
      读出请求自己的 tools / tool_choice / parallel_tool_calls
      （tools 与 tool choice 会渲染进会话，必须按原请求的样子渲染）
对 i 从 len−2 递减到 0（新者在先）:
  若 messages[i+1].role == assistant:        # 该消息之后开始了 assistant 回复 → 一个轮次在此结束
    turn   = messages[..=i]                   # 到该消息为止的会话前缀
    m      = |render(turn, NoGenerationPrompt, 本请求的 tool 上下文)|
    保留 m > 0
至多取 8 个（新者优先）
```

桥侧二次过滤（[stepped.rs:L406-L416](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/bridge/stepped.rs#L406-L416)）：只保留 \(0 < m < h\) 的 mark——**严格小于本请求的 `history_tokens`**。这与契约文档（step.rs 第 65 行 "strictly less than `history_tokens`"）一一对应：等于或超过当前历史的 mark 不可能是更早轮次的边界。

### 4.3 normalize_chat_requests：effort 别名规范化与洋葱顺序

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

OpenAI 的 `reasoning_effort` 词表是 `none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max`，但**具体 checkpoint 的 chat 模板可能只认更窄的词表**：Qwen3.8 的模板只接受 `xhigh|medium|low`，其它值直接 `raise_exception`——而 pinned 的 vendored 前端把这次 raise 变成 **500 而不是 400**。调用方发一个完全合法的 OpenAI 值 `high`，却得到服务器内部错误。

这一层的职责：在请求到达路由**之前**，把模板不认识的值改写成语义最近的别名（`high`/`max` → `xhigh`，`minimal` → `low`）。两条设计纪律让它不至于变成「拍脑袋映射」：

1. **改写集由被服务模板自己裁决**：启动时用同一渲染器对每个候选值渲染一个最小请求，只有「模板拒绝 from 且接受 to」的别名才启用。模板本来就接受 OpenAI 值的线（今天的所有非 Qwen3.8 线，包括 Kimi K3）一个改写都不启用，调用方的值逐字到达。
2. **探测有前置闸门**：只有 config.json（顶层或 `text_config`）带 `output_gate_type` 标记的 Qwen3.8 一类存档才值得探测，其它线零启动开销。

两条**故意不改写**的通道（见 [reasoning_effort.rs:L20-L26](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L20-L26)）：显式的 `chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort`（调用方在直接对模板说话）与逐请求的 `chat_template` 覆盖（其词表启动探测从未量过）。两者保留完全控制权，代价是值越界时由它们自己承担拒绝。

**洋葱顺序**（[mod.rs:L493-L500](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs#L493-L500)）：`normalize_chat_requests(mark_history(extend_router(router)))`——effort 层包在 history 层**外面**。注释一句话点题：*"Effort normalization is outermost so the boundary measures the template under the value the route will render with."* 4.1.3 里我们看到边界测量的 `chat_options` 会读 `reasoning_effort` 并用它渲染；若 effort 层在内层，边界会在**改写前**的值下测 T——而模板的 generation prompt（如思考分支的开合）可以随 effort 变化，T 就可能量错。外层先改写，内层量到的才是路由真正要渲染的世界。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
load_model_backends(model_id)        # 失败仅 warn 降级：整形层整体关闭，服务照常
  ├─ probe_effort_aliases(model_id, backends)
  │    ├─ probe_warranted? 读 config.json（顶层或 text_config）找 output_gate_type 标记
  │    │    无标记 / 无本地 config（HF id）→ 空表，零改写
  │    ├─ 对每个候选值 {high, xhigh, max, minimal, low} 渲染一个最小请求
  │    └─ 别名 (from→to) 启用 ⟺ 模板拒绝 from ∧ 接受 to
  └─ Boundary::new(backends)         # 测量器；backends 为 None 时 mark_history 不挂
```

请求期（`normalize_request`，仅 `POST /v1/chat/completions`）：

```text
缓冲 body（上限 BODY_LIMIT = 128 MiB）
rewrite_reasoning_effort(body, aliases):
  body 不是 JSON / 无 reasoning_effort / 值非字符串 / 值不在别名表 → 原样返回
  body 带字符串型 chat_template 覆盖 → 原样返回（覆盖模板的词表不归我们猜）
  否则 reasoning_effort ← 别名目标值，重写 body
改写过 → 重写 Content-Length
放行给内层（history 测量层）
```

体读失败的错误契约（`body_read_error`）：超长独占 **413**，其它读失败保持 **400**，两者都用上游同款 OpenAI 风格 JSON 错误信封（`invalid_request_error`），保证状态类别与成因都活着。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**候选别名与探测值**（[reasoning_effort.rs:L69-L87](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L69-L87)）：`CANDIDATE_ALIASES = [("high","xhigh"), ("max","xhigh"), ("minimal","low")]`；`probe_values` 收齐所有源与目标去重——每个候选只凭**自己的**渲染判定武装，不从 config 想当然。

**入口与前置闸门**（[reasoning_effort.rs:L99-L147](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L99-L147)）：`probe_effort_aliases` 先过 `probe_warranted`——读模型目录的 config.json，在顶层或 `text_config` 下找 `output_gate_type`；目录都没有（HF id）不是错误，直接跳过。backends 没加载也只有 warn 没有 mapping——「没有可读的模板判定，就没有改写任何东西的正当性」。

**模板探测**（[reasoning_effort.rs:L152-L190](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L152-L190)）：`probe_template` 对每个候选值渲染一条 `probe_request`（单条 user 消息、`reasoning_effort` 塞进 `ChatOptions`），`is_ok()` 即「接受」；别名保留条件 `!accepts(from) && accepts(to)`。第 169-190 行的最小请求把其它字段全部放在「vendored 路由对纯文本 chat 的默认解析值」上——探测世界与请求世界同构。

**中间层与改写函数**（[reasoning_effort.rs:L195-L226](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L195-L226) 与 [L259-L285](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L259-L285)）：别名表为空时 `normalize_chat_requests` 原样返回 router（零开销）。`rewrite_reasoning_effort` 第 268-273 行的 `chat_template` 覆盖守卫注释值得逐字读：别名是**默认模板**的判定，逐请求覆盖是另一张有自己词表的模板——按默认模板的权威去猜覆盖模板，可能把覆盖本可接受的值改写成它反而拒绝的值。

**错误信封**（[reasoning_effort.rs:L233-L252](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L233-L252)）：`body_read_error` 复刻 `vllm_server` 的 `ApiError::to_error_response` 形状；`LengthLimitError` 独占 413，注释说明这层出现之前路由报的就是 400，非超长读失败保持该类别。

**探测的两组反例测试**（[reasoning_effort.rs:L427-L459](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L427-L459)）：`GUARDED_TEMPLATE`（Qwen3.8 原生守卫形状，只认 `xhigh|medium|low`）武装全部三条别名；`ACCEPTING_TEMPLATE`（带标记的 config 却用自定义模板接受 `low|high|max`）只武装 `minimal→low`——**标记只是「值得探测」，不是「必然改写」**；无标记或无本地 config 则探测整个跳过。

**洋葱装配点**（[mod.rs:L416-L435](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs#L416-L435) 与 [L493-L500](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs#L493-L500)）：backends 由装配骨架加载一次（失败仅 warn、整形降级，u4-l2 讲过）；第 434-435 行在同一处派生 effort 别名表与 Boundary；第 496-499 行在 `serve_with_router_extension` 的回调里按「effort 最外、history 次外、用户 extend_router 最内」包洋葱。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：亲眼看到「别名由模板裁决」而不是由标记裁决。

1. **操作步骤**：
   - 读 [reasoning_effort.rs:L371-L377](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L371-L377) 的两个模板 fixture：`GUARDED_TEMPLATE`（守卫在 thinking 分支内，只认 `xhigh|medium|low`）与 `ACCEPTING_TEMPLATE`（接受 `low|high|max`）。
   - 手工推演两个模板各自的探测结果：对每个值 `{high, xhigh, max, minimal, low}` 判定接受/拒绝，再套用 `!accepts(from) && accepts(to)`。
   - 运行 `cargo test -p pegainfer-frontend --lib vllm::reasoning_effort`（无 GPU，fixture 在 tempdir 里自建）。
2. **需要观察的现象**：守卫模板武装 `[("high","xhigh"), ("max","xhigh"), ("minimal","low")]`；接受模板只武装 `[("minimal","low")]`；无标记 config 与不存在的 HF id 都得到空表。
3. **预期结果**：三个探测测试全部通过，与你的手算一致（待本地验证）。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么探测只在带 `output_gate_type` 标记的存档上跑，而不是所有模型都跑一遍？
**答案**：省启动开销只是次要原因；更根本的是**正当性**：别名表的语义是「这个模板拒绝 from、接受 to」。绝大多数线的模板接受全部 OpenAI 值，探测结果必然是空表；标记把「已知会限制 effort 词表的这一代存档」圈出来，让其它线连一次渲染探测都不必付，也绝不冒误改写的险。

**练习 2**：请求带 `"chat_template": "{{ '' }}"` 且 `reasoning_effort: "high"`，会发生什么？
**答案**：原样放行，不改写（`rewrite_reasoning_effort` 的覆盖守卫）。理由：这张临时模板的词表启动探测从未量过——它可能接受 `high`，按默认模板的权威把 `high` 改成 `xhigh` 反而可能弄坏一个本来能渲染的请求。测试 `a_per_request_template_override_keeps_the_callers_effort_value`（[reasoning_effort.rs:L325-L340](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/reasoning_effort.rs#L325-L340)）同时验证了 `chat_template: null`（无覆盖）时改写照常生效。

**练习 3**：把两层洋葱反过来包（history 在外、effort 在内），哪个数量会错、怎么错？
**答案**：会错的是 T。边界测量的 `chat_options` 从 body 读 `reasoning_effort`（history.rs 第 217 行）并用它渲染两次；effort 在内层意味着测量发生在改写**之前**，模板实际会以改写后的值渲染（例如 thinking 分支的开合随 effort 变化，generation prompt 的 token 数随之不同）。测出的 T 对应的是调用方发来的值，而路由渲染用的是改写后的值——快照点落在错误的 token 上，下一轮从快照恢复就会差几个 token。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务：给 echo-server 发两轮对话，推算并（可选）观测第二轮的 `history_tokens` 与 `history_marks`。**

1. **准备**：从工作区根目录运行 `cargo run -p pegainfer-frontend --example echo-server`（无 GPU、无权重；模型 fixture 在 [examples/echo-model/](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-model/config.json#L1-L6)，其 config 无 `output_gate_type` 标记——顺带确认：这个部署的 effort 别名表必然为空，第一层洋葱实际是透传的）。
2. **第一轮**：`curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"model":"echo","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}],"max_tokens":64}'`，记下 assistant 回复（echo 线把 prompt 吐回来）。
3. **第二轮**：构造 body：`messages = [第一轮 user, 第一轮 assistant 回复, 新的 user 消息]`，再次请求。
4. **手工推算**（依据 4.1/4.2 的算法，按结构推）：
   - 第二轮请求恰有一个历史边界（第一轮 user 消息后面跟着 assistant 消息），所以 `history_marks` 是**单元素**向量；
   - 该元素的值 =「到第一轮 user 为止的会话，不带 generation prompt 渲染后的 token 数」= 第一轮请求**当时的** `history_tokens`；
   - 第二轮的 `history_tokens` = 第二轮整条 prompt 的 token 数 − T（T 默认 mode 下 ≥ 1）；桥侧过滤后必有 `marks[0] < history_tokens`。
   - echo-model 无 `tokenizer_config.json`，chat 路由用 vendored 默认模板渲染——**具体数值无法纸面确定，待本地验证**。
5. **（可选）观测**：echo-server 不初始化日志后端，`debug!` 不会输出；想看到真实数字，可在自己检出的 [history.rs:L435-L450](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/history.rs#L435-L450) 的 `mark_generation_prompt` 里临时加一行 `eprintln!("T={tokens:?} marks={marks:?}")`，重跑 echo-server 发第二轮请求，观测后还原。观测值应满足第 4 步的结构断言。
6. **核验**：把推算结果对照 [step.rs:L51-L67](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/step.rs#L51-L67) 的两个字段注释逐句核对——你的每个数是否都能在注释里找到一句话为其背书。
7. **答问**：向 echo-server 发 `{"messages":[...],"add_generation_prompt":false}` 或最后一条是 assistant 且 `continue_final_message:true` 的请求时，T 是多少、`history_tokens` 是多少、这对快照恢复意味着什么？（答案：T=0，`history_tokens = L − 0 = L`，整个 prompt 都是 history——因为根本没有「即将生成的尾巴」，会话的下一轮会从 prompt 的**最后一个 token** 之后接着重复，快照点就在 prompt 末尾。）

## 6. 本讲小结

- **边界测量的形态**：chat 层在路由前面把最后一条消息单独渲染两遍（带/不带 generation prompt），\( T = |W| - \operatorname{LCP}(W, W') \)；跨界 token 计入 T，边界只向历史方向退。桥侧用只有它知道的整条 prompt 长度做 \( h = L - T \)（`checked_sub`，装不下即 `None`）。
- **marks 是「更早轮次的 history_tokens」**：每个被 assistant 消息紧跟的消息处结束过一个更早请求；到该处为止、按请求自己的工具上下文、不带尾巴渲染的 token 数即 mark。新者在先、至多 8 个、桥侧严格小于 `history_tokens` 才保留——供 pooled tier 从更早快照恢复。
- **测量用的是路由自己的 renderer 与 tokenizer**，mode/模板控制逐字段复刻路由解析；`add_generation_prompt=false` 与 `continue_final_message=true` 都使 T=0、整个 prompt 是 history。
- **读不懂就放行**：非 JSON、无 messages、渲染失败、backends 未加载——任何一层量不动都不报错，body 原样穿过，调度器看到 `None`/空，错误留给路由自己报。两个键是「服务器对自己模板的测量」，调用方带同名键会被覆盖。
- **effort 规范化由模板裁决**：启动探测渲染每个候选值，`!accepts(from) && accepts(to)` 才武装别名（`high/max→xhigh`、`minimal→low`）；`output_gate_type` 标记是「值得探测」的闸门而非改写命令；`chat_template_kwargs` 直连与逐请求 `chat_template` 覆盖两条通道故意不改写。
- **洋葱顺序是正确性约束**：effort 最外、history 次外——边界必须用「路由真正渲染用的值」量 T；测量与渲染在 `spawn_blocking` 里做，秒级渲染不压 async worker；改写后重写 `Content-Length`，超长独占 413、其它读失败保持 400，共用 OpenAI 错误信封。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- **u4-l5（特殊服务面）**：看同一洋葱里最内层 `extend_router` 的另外两个形态——prefill-only 门与 LoRA 路由合并，理解「整形层」与「能力路由层」的分工。
- **u4-l6（可观测性）**：marks 命中与否最终体现在 prefix-cache 计数器上；去看 `SchedulerMetrics` 的 `prefix_cache` 累计计数如何从调度器走到 `/metrics`，把本讲的「快照 miss 只是 miss」落到数字上。
- **源码延伸**：带快照语义的调度器如何消费 `history_tokens`/`history_marks`，可从 `pegainfer-qwen3` 或 `pegainfer-qwen35`（Gated DeltaNet 线，正是「状态不能回滚」的动机来源）的调度器代码里 grep `history_tokens` 入手；`docs/models/qwen35/` 下有对应的模型线文档。

Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.
